question: Which of the following rivers is the largest tributary of the Indus river?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Chenab__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chenab **is the largest tributary of the Indus River.
 
• **Chenab **is formed by two streams, the Chandra and the Bhaga, which join at Tandi near Keylong in Himachal Pradesh. 
 
• Chenab is a major river which flows in India and also in Pakistan.
 
• It is one of the five major rivers of the Punjab region. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Beas is a riverfront town in the city of Amritsar in Punjab.
 
• The **Ravi River** is a transboundary river that crosses between northwestern India and eastern Pakistan. 
 
• The Sutlej or Satluj River is the longest of the five rivers that flow through the historic crossroads region of Punjab in northern India and Pakistan.
